## About
Packer Norris Parts is a joint venture between Al Packer's White Marsh Ford and Norris Ford of Dundalk, both well known Baltimore Ford dealerships. We're not just a parts warehouse. We're the people you call when you need a Ford, Lincoln, Mercury or Motorcraft part.
We work with collision repair shops, fleets and government agencies, Ford and Lincoln dealers, mechanical repair shops, and individual owners and enthusiasts. Our retail parts store is open to the public, and our drivers handle deliveries for businesses on our routes.
We hold a 4.5 rating from 136 Google reviews. One reviewer thanks Tracy for great work through the years, and another says working with Tim in the parts department gets them the correct part.

## Services
- Genuine Ford Collision Parts: Collision parts for body shops and anyone fixing a Ford after a wreck.
- Genuine Ford Maintenance Parts and Genuine Ford Repair Parts: Factory maintenance and repair parts for mechanical shops, fleets and owners.
- Ford Power Stroke Diesel Parts and Ford Super Duty Parts: Parts for diesel and Super Duty trucks, with specialists who can answer your questions.
- Ford Racing Parts and Ford Performance Parts: Performance and racing parts for Ford owners and enthusiasts.
- Motorcraft Parts: Motorcraft parts alongside our genuine Ford lines.
- Online Ford Parts Catalog: The easiest way to order. Look up parts, check pricing and availability, and arrange pick-up or delivery.
- Parts delivery: Our drivers deliver to businesses in parts of Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, DC and Northern Virginia.
- PNP Parts Account: Sign up for an account and qualify for preferred pricing.

## FAQ
Q: Can individual Ford owners buy parts here?
A: Yes. Our Packer Norris Parts retail store is open to the public, and we work with individual Ford owners and enthusiasts too.

Q: How do I place an order?
A: Call, fax, email, order through our Online Ford Parts Catalog, or come see us in person at the retail parts store.

Q: What should I have ready when I call or come in?
A: One reviewer put it well: bring your make, model, year and VIN so we can find the right part.

Q: What about customers outside your delivery routes?
A: If we can't get to you by personal delivery, we ship parts by UPS or FedEx anywhere in the U.S.
